dedupe_keys.name: urban morphology mobility public space housing and environment fieldwork in santiago de los caballeros 2026

description: This dataset holds urban, environmental and social information from fieldwork by Urbanismo III students in selected neighbourhoods of Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic, to evaluate neighbourhood habitability. It was published on Mendeley Data in May 2026 (three versions) by Gilkauris Maria Rojas Cortorreal, for fieldwork in the January to April 2026 academic term. Data follow six dimensions: urban morphology, mobility and accessibility, public space and urban equipment, housing and building conditions, environmental conditions, and social perception and neighbourhood satisfaction; methods were direct observation, urban mapping and photography, covering land use, roads, pedestrian access, public space quality, vegetation, environmental risks, housing condition, perceived security and satisfaction. Coverage: selected neighbourhoods of one city. Access: Mendeley Data download. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a qualitative-descriptive student survey, not a representative sample. Simulation uses: neighbourhood vulnerability and public space quality baselines in a Caribbean city. Related records: the Inclusive Public Space interviews and the Public Space Patterns dataset.
